chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / SEZ / BTP Units

business_rules.rule_description:
6.15 Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / SEZ / BTP Units
Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / BTP / SEZ units shall be counted towards
NFE provided that such goods are permissible for procurement by these units.
